charters_note: each charter row is the stored Attestation; it is named by its own persist_row_hash (recompute it), which is the charter_digest a version adopts; recovery_commitments is attestation_envelope.recovery_commitments

expected.rule: CC 4.2.6 (rc20): the commitment in force for a holder is the one named by the latest row of the lineage (by prev_head_digest links) that names one for that holder: a recovery version (next_recovery_commitment for new_holder_key_id) or a charter version (the genesis version, or one whose charter_digest differs from its predecessor's: every recovery_commitments entry); a recovery spends the commitment then in force for old_holder_key_id; a spent commitment named again names none

hash: persist_row_hash = lowercase hex SHA-256 of canonical_bytes; canonical_bytes = PythonJsonDumpsCanonicalizer(serde value of the Family minus persist_row_hash and consent_role, every RFC-3339 instant with more than 6 fractional digits truncated to microseconds)
